name: Absolvers
note: VoA prints no Absolvers Chapter Traits and calls the Absolvers a Blood Angels Successor Chapter (VoA pp.30, 78); Core p.71 calls them of unknown succession. GM ruling: they take the Blood Angels Chapter Traits, the Red Thirst (Gene-seed) included, even for Primaris (docs/rules-flow.md §11.23). Also Core p.71.
